item.title: PCB chief Mohsin Naqvi asks ICC to shift Bangladesh’s T20 World Cup 2026 matches to Pakistan- Report
item.description: In light of Bangladesh's escalating tensions with India, the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) has reportedly indicated interest in hosting the country's matches in the men's 2026 T20 World Cup in Pakistan. Concerned about the safety of its players in India, the BCB is in talks with the International Cricket Council (ICC). Along with other international body delegations, the ICC and its chairman, Jay Shah, have been in Mumbai for discussions at the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) office.

item.title: IND v NZ 2026: Washington Sundar ruled out of remaining ODI series due to injury - Report
item.description: India’s spin all-rounder Washington Sundar has been ruled out of the remainder of the three-ODI series against New Zealand after suffering a strain during the opening match in Vadodara on Sunday (January 11), TOI reported. According to the report, it is doubtful if Sundar will be able to return to action for the five-match T20I series against the Kiwis, starting January 21 in Nagpur.
